summary.text: Joe McGonagle (listed on Ballotpedia as Joseph McGonagle Jr.) is a Democratic state representative from the 28th Middlesex District who has served since January 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Veterans and Federal Affairs.

paragraphs.text: Joe McGonagle assumed office in the Massachusetts House on January 7, 2015.
For 2025-2026 he chaired the Veterans and Federal Affairs Joint Committee, and in 2023-2024 he chaired the House Operations, Facilities and Security Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
